description: Peregrine web layer capabilities: notifications + opener (open/reveal finished file — open-path + reveal need explicit allow, default only covers URLs) + dialog (native save-dir picker). The daemon sidecar is spawned from the RUST shell (no JS shell perms needed — least privilege), and the download surface is daemon REST/WS over loopback, not IPC commands. Batch-2 adds autostart (launch-at-login toggle) and window-state restore.
